title: Agent Benchmark — Synthesis Contract
description: Evidence hierarchy, scoring dimensions, required report sections, recommendation constraints, and the quality gate for the Flue agent benchmark.

dimensions.short_description: Canonical result text or R2 artifact
Durable artifact handling and R2 manifest
Low ops burden for single-user deployment

props.content: Goal: produce one concise but comprehensive report comparing the repository with peers and recommend the smallest reliable architecture for a one-user agent. Evidence order: 1) supplied transcript; 2) repository source & tests; 3) pinned framework source; 4) upstream docs; 5) secondary sources only when primary unavailable.

rows.title: Required report sections
rows.body: Exec verdict; root causes & cascades; architecture strengths/gaps; peer selection & limits; scored matrix; per-peer findings; responsibilities; Cloudflare primitives; recommended architecture & state model; roadmap; test suite; risks & gaps; sources.

rows.title: Recommendation constraints
rows.body: Preserve authorization, isolation, redaction, allowlists, DO migration compatibility. Prefer additive app-layer fixes over runtime rewrites.

props.body: Phase-0 acceptance: result and outbox rows survive Sandbox/Worker teardown; resend reads ledger with zero model/Sandbox calls; typecheck/tests/build pass; new tests assert these invariants.
